assumptions.decision: Set MSRV to 1.85 instead of the spec's 1.83 because edition 2024 (which the spec also requires) only stabilized in 1.85.

Build host is macOS arm64 (darwin). Linux-only subsystems (overlayfs, CRIU) are scaffolded with macOS-stub fallbacks; bit-exact replay tests against vLLM/SGLang require a CUDA host and run only when env $PF_HAS_GPU=1. Documented in agent_docs/world-layer.md and agent_docs/cache-layer.md.

PyPI / npm / crates.io / GHCR publish steps are wired in CI (Phase 12) but require operator-supplied tokens (`PYPI_API_TOKEN`, `NPM_TOKEN`, `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`, `GHCR_TOKEN`). The build agent does not have these and cannot perform the actual `1.0.0` publish from this environment; the workflow yaml is the deliverable.

The 60-second demo asciinema script is checked in under demo/. The actual recording requires the operator to run it (the agent cannot record its own terminal in this harness). Script is the deliverable; rendered .cast file is operator-produced.
